ownership.counterScope: JS WebGPU API result references managed by the bindings ledger; borrowed Context/device/adapter/queue references and internal temporary helpers are excluded.
ownership.wrapperScope: Actual JS wrapper weak-finalizer callbacks; native API release does not imply wrapper or CPU metadata finalization.
ownership.canvas: One current JS texture per lease; expire/destroy invalidates private tokens and releases owned API refs without destroying Surface-owned backing.
ownership.androidTransientAcquire: Only Timeout/Outdated/Lost with a live device/configuration may render a discard-only temporary texture; Error, device loss and OOM do not qualify.
ownership.androidPauseHold: At most one Context-owned old presentation Surface and one explicit ANativeWindow reference, retired on new readiness or normal teardown.

scope: Source/build identity of memory ownership and same-Activity Surface recovery only; runtime and release acceptance remain separate.
